_comment: Storyboard for the Grade 4 Science unit lecture film, Lesson 8 Energy Everywhere. Rendered by tools/create-ehel-unit-lecture.js. See lecture-video/BRIEF.md. Every beat is one narration clip; art.at names the phrases a picture waits for, and the page refuses to load if a phrase is not in its beat's say. The chapters follow LESSON['lecture'] in order (energy everywhere; nothing moves without it; never made, never lost; where it goes; leaking out - the last part's 'track it, record it and chart it' becoming its own chapter), in the lesson's own words: its energy hunt's six cards, its transfers demo's five frames, and its bounce experiment drawn by the lesson's own sim (ART.sim energyDrop, the drawing its Drop the ball button steps through, whose bars always total 100).
title: Energy Everywhere
subtitle: Grade 4 Science
objectives: Know that energy is present in all matter and in sound, light and heat.
Know that energy cannot be made, lost, used up or destroyed but it can be transferred.
Know that energy is required for any movement or action to happen.

Know that not all energy is transferred from one object to another, but often some energy during a process can be transferred to the surrounding environment and this can be detected as sound, light or temperature increase.
Make a prediction describing some possible outcomes of an enquiry.
Present and interpret results using tables, bar charts and dot plots.
Collect and record observations and/or measurements in tables and diagrams.

beats.say: Energy is what makes things happen. It is in everything around you.
You cannot hold it. You can only see what it does.
Let us go on an energy hunt. Six things, and all six have energy.
A moving ball has energy. The faster it goes, the more it has.
A stretched band has energy stored in it, waiting. Let go, and it moves.
Sound is energy travelling through the air. Light and heat are energy from the Sun.
Your food has energy stored in it too. Energy is in every material.
Energy is not only electricity. A hot cup and a loud drum have it too.
Every movement and every action needs energy.
Your muscles take it out of your food, so that you can run and kick.
A lamp takes it from electricity. A plant takes it from light.
Take the energy away, and nothing happens at all.
Here is the big rule. Energy cannot be made out of nothing.
And it cannot be destroyed. It is never used up, whatever people say.
It can only be transferred: moved from one thing to another.
Or moved from one form to another. Food to muscle.
Then muscle to ball. Your kick sends the energy into the ball, and it flies.
Now drop a ball. Before you let go, predict what the bounces will do.
Held up high, the ball has stored energy. As it falls, that becomes movement energy.
Bounce one. Thud! It comes back up to three marks.
Bounce two, and only two marks. Some energy left as sound and warmth.
Bounce three, just one mark. Each bounce is lower than the last.
None of it vanished. The bars always add up to the same total.
The ball hits the wall. Thump. Some of its energy became sound.
And some warmed the wall a tiny bit. None of it was lost.
A lamp is the same. Electricity goes in, light comes out, and the bulb gets warm.
A warm bulb is not broken. Every transfer leaks a little to the surroundings.
You read each bounce off the marked scale. Then it goes in a table.
First bounce, three marks. Second, two marks. Third, one mark.
Then you turn the table into a bar chart, one bar for each bounce.
A falling staircase. That is the pattern: energy transferred away every bounce.
Energy is in everything, and in sound, light and heat.
Nothing happens without it, and it can never be made or destroyed.
It is only transferred, and some always leaks out to the surroundings.
